mapper.select: SELECT task.task_id, task.tenant_id, task.instance_id, task.node_key, task.task_type, task.assignee, task.proxy_user_id, task.agent_setting_id, task.status, task.lock_version AS version FROM wf_task task INNER JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.instance_id = task.instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = task.tenant_id WHERE task.task_id > #{afterTaskId} AND task.status = 'TODO' AND task.assignee IS NOT NULL AND instance.status = 'RUNNING' AND instance.deleted = 0 ORDER BY task.task_id LIMIT 100
